CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2567 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 4ef1a8270f3bd30bc6c313c950f6f44713a1442d. Bus nonce: cdda16118cf7b9ea9ddfcd538c68d6d3. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 4ef1a8270f3bd30bc6c313c950f6f44713a1442d`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 4ef1a8270f3bd30bc6c313c950f6f44713a1442d` or `Fix review: blocked 4ef1a8270f3bd30bc6c313c950f6f44713a1442d <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: cdda16118cf7b9ea9ddfcd538c68d6d3`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `4ef1a8270f3bd30bc6c313c950f6f44713a1442d` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2567 4ef1a8270f3bd30bc6c313c950f6f44713a1442d") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2567-cdda1611`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Fix reviewer for PR #2567 (R10-ROW-ONLY-UPDATE, branch fix/r10-row-only-update, hot files pr_args.sh and update_pr.sh), round 5: the fixer's round 4 plus main merged in; the earlier merge verdict (16:21Z) was voided by hot-file conflicts, rule 18. Review from a detached worktree at the head with the finder's harness at both ends, the step-1 mutation proof (every mutant killed), the null control, the class attack, git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main <head>, check-runs read once at the end (pending: say which; nightly-status red is the known main-level red, the body must answer it in ## Red checks per rule 22). Earlier verdicts do not carry; read them in the PR comments for the blocks you must verify are fixed. Rule 19: every observation in your verdict carries `Carry: <GROUP>` (a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster) or `Carry: dismissed <reason of 2+ words>`; run python3 tools/audit/carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster over your verdict text and require 0 unrouted. The group is on the roster. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly.
